confidence_notes: Food anchors use 2026 local restaurant price ranges and travel guides. Accommodation is a holistic year-typical estimate with extra uncertainty from July demand and limited supply; cocktail and wine prices are inferred from local beer prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cesky Krumlov is a small, highly tourist-oriented Czech town. I estimate its three-star room near Prague and Zakopane levels, below Brno, with basic rooms and hostel options slightly above those comparisons because lodging supply is limited.
